verdict.rationale: Deel exposes a REST API, sandbox environment, and webhooks that can be called programmatically without any UI, and the MCP server allows agent-driven invocation of tools like listOfContracts/createTimeOffRequest — all of which support headless/automated use. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD integration, GitHub Actions examples, service-account/headless auth flow tailored for pipelines, or scripted deployment guidance. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, headless auth token generation flow, and any evidence of automated test suites running against the sandbox in CI.
